records.deidentified_narrative: on [date] i officer a. villalobos #211 responded to henderson village apartments (1480 us-259 s.) in reference to an unknown disturbance. during our investigation it was discovered that landrecia finley was at ut health henderson due to her being struck by a vehicle during the disturbance. when i arrived at ut health henderson i spoke with finley. she said a subject named stevie dunham got in his car, an older model buick with unknown plates at the time, and purposely drove up a curb where she was at and hit her. she said she went up in the air and landed on the ground. when i asked finley if she remembered how high she went she said she didn't know but she did go up in the air. finley believed stevie intentionally aimed the car at her. as i was speaking with finley, she told me someone sent her a video of dunham hitting her with the car. finley showed me on her phone the video which i saw a white vehicle swerve striking finley on her left side, bumping her with the vehicle then seen driving away. the vehicle never went up a curb as finley described. in the video you can see a large group of people walking around. i asked finley to email me the video to my work email, but her phone was not allowing her to attach it to an email to send for some reason. to attempt to preserve the video for evidentiary purposes i detached my body worn camera from my chest and pointed it towards finley's phone and recorded the video. tynesia heckard ([phone]) said she saw stevie hit finley with his car and she saw finley go up in the air and land on the ground. it should be noted finley and heckerd positively identified stevie dunham as the driver in the vehicle that hit her and then drove off. this incident occurred on private property inside the apartment complex. since stevie dunham was no longer on scene he was not arrested at the time, case was referred to detectives for follow up investigation see henderson police department [case id]. eor- a. villalobos #211

records.deidentified_narrative: see related sn# [phone]. this is the dallas police departments 91st traffic fatality for the 2023. unit 1 was traveling w/b [roadway], south of the north curb. unit 2 ( pedestrian in a wheel chair ) was traveling in a southerly direction across the w/b traffic lanes of [roadway]. unit 2 failed to yield right of way - motor vehicle, entered into unit 1'[roadway] of travel and was struck by the front left of unit 1 to the left side [medical facility] where she succumbed to her injuries and was pronounced deceased at 10:[medical facility] physician. video of the incident was captured by a business surveillance video that shows unit 2 crossing where there was no crosswalk present when unit 2 was struck by unit 1. vehicle crimes unit detectives came out to the scene and took photos and did a drone fly over. a 3d laser scan was done of the scene. the crash scene and all interviews were recorded on body worn camera. the video and or photos were saved to evidence. com on id #23-1760809. this report will be incomplete pending the blood toxicology results for unit 2. unit 1 was on the roadway that was level and then goes into a slight down grade. unit 2 was crossing the roadway on this slight down grade. as unit 1 crested the roadway and started to go down grade, unit 2 was below driver 1's original line of sight and when driver 1 saw unit 2, driver 1 steered unit 1 to the right to avoid unit 2 but ended up striking her. **the crash was initially modified by txdot stating that unit 2's blood tested positive for drugs and the drug category was other drugs ** on [date], this supplement was made to add the blood toxicology results for unit 2. the blood toxicology results from the collin county medical examiner's office for unit 2 shows no ethanol or drugs present, except for over-the-counter medication. ** this report is now complete. **

records.deidentified_narrative: while traveling south on south broadway unit 1 was traveling in the number 3 lane. a vehicle was in front of him and slowing to turn right onto [roadway]. driver changed to the number 2/[roadway] before entering the intersection with a green light. while nearing the valero and 7/11 gas stations he looked at both signs to check gas prices. driver stated that as he finished looking at both signs and he looked forward, the pedestrian was directly in front of his vehicle [roadway]. based on the video footage, the victim was struck even with the southern most entrance to the valero gas station and was pushed by the vehicle approximately 40-50 yards from the force of the impact, which knocked him out of both shoes and rolled under the vehicle tires. due to the rain slick roads, driver said he skidded a bit when he applied the brakes after striking the pedestrian and was unable to stop immediately. after he came to a stop, he turned around to find the person and this is why his vehicle ended [roadway].
